title: [SEC1] render* functions silently fail if DOM elements missing
description: Functions like renderContactList (line 158), renderChatList (line 256), renderThread (line 382) all check 'if (!element) return' and silently exit if DOM elements are missing. This means bugs in index.html (missing #contact-list, #chat-list, #message-thread) won't surface as errors—they'll fail silently with no warning. Future developers removing or renaming elements won't know why content doesn't appear. Consider logging a warning or throwing an error in development mode.
